My supervisor says I am the most reliable worker on the floor. Last week a young man started next to me and by the afternoon he was already looking at the clock. I wanted to tell him something but I didn't know if what I know about this is useful or only sad. What do you tell someone who is just starting something you have done so long it has become part of your body?
